library(nlmixr2lib)
library(PKNCA)

library(dplyr)

# Model and source

Transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy (ATTR-CM) arises when circulating
transthyretin (TTR) tetramers dissociate into monomers that misfold and deposit
as amyloid. Methven Jeknic et al. built a mass-action systems model of that
pathway to compare the approved treatment modalities on one footing: the
tetramer stabilisers acoramidis and tafamidis, and the TTR-production knockdown
agent vutrisiran. The model's disease readout is *monomer efflux*, the rate at
which unfolded monomers form amyloid; its running integral is the amyloid
formed, and comparisons are made relative to untreated wild-type ATTR-CM
(ATTRwt).

The paper contributes two models, both built in Python and both written out in
the supplement:

* `MethvenJeknic_2026_attrcm_fpe_invitro` -- the fluorescent probe exclusion
  (FPE) assay model used to estimate how strongly each stabiliser binds TTR and
  albumin in human serum (Supplemental Equations 1-7).
* `MethvenJeknic_2026_attrcm_qsp` -- the physiological model of TTR production,
  dissociation, unfolding, clearance and amyloid formation, with the
  stabilisers and vutrisiran (Supplemental Equations 8-16).

```{r model-meta}
fpe_mod <- rxode2::rxode(readModelDb("MethvenJeknic_2026_attrcm_fpe_invitro"))
qsp_mod <- rxode2::rxode(readModelDb("MethvenJeknic_2026_attrcm_qsp"))
```

* Citation: `r qsp_mod$reference`
* Physiological model: `r qsp_mod$description`
* FPE model: `r fpe_mod$description`
* Article: <https://doi.org/10.1002/psp4.70277> (open access, PMC13244665)
* Authors' code: <https://github.com/BridgeBioAnalytics/ttr-mechanistic-model>

# Population

Neither model is fitted to individual patients. The FPE model was fitted to
published serum FPE time courses (Miller et al. 2018) together with plasma
protein binding data and isothermal-calorimetry binding constants (Table S3).
The physiological model was calibrated to cohort-mean serum TTR in ATTRwt,
variant ATTR-CM (ATTRv) and protective p.Thr139Met cohorts, TTR turnover and
half-life, the thermodynamics of tetramer dissociation and monomer unfolding,
and the changes in serum TTR seen with acoramidis (ATTRibute-CM), tafamidis
(ATTR-ACT) and vutrisiran (HELIOS-B) (Table S4). The ATTRv parameter set uses
the biophysics of p.Val142Ile, the majority variant in those trials.

Stabilisers are held at a constant total serum concentration: acoramidis at its
10 uM trough and tafamidis at its 26 uM peak, so the comparison favours
tafamidis on exposure.

```{r population}
str(qsp_mod$population)
str(fpe_mod$population)
```

# FPE assay model

In the FPE assay a covalent stilbene probe and a stabiliser are added together
to human serum. The probe fluoresces once it has reacted with a TTR tetramer
whose thyroxine pockets are both empty, so the more strongly a drug occupies
TTR, the slower fluorescence rises. Albumin competes with TTR for the drug. The
model's dissociation constants are those of Table 1.

The reference points below are the human-serum FPE data of Miller et al. 2018
(Figure 4) as digitised by the authors and deposited with their code; for each
condition the time point nearest 1, 3 and 6 hours is shown.

```{r fpe-reference}
fpe_ref <- data.frame(
  drug = c(
    rep("acoramidis", 15),
    rep("tafamidis", 21)
  ),
  conc_uM = c(
    rep(c(0, 1.25, 2.5, 5, 10), each = 3),
    rep(c(0, 1.25, 2.5, 5, 10, 20, 40), each = 3)
  ),
  time = c(
    1.003, 2.992, 5.984, 1.004, 2.989, 5.989, 1.004, 3, 5.989, 1.014, 3, 6,
    0.993, 2.989, 5.989,
    0.989, 2.989, 6, 0.989, 3, 6, 1, 3, 6, 1, 3, 6, 1, 2.989, 6, 1, 3, 6,
    0.989, 3, 6
  ),
  fluor_obs = c(
    0.534, 0.866, 1.004, 0.364, 0.685, 0.848, 0.268, 0.55, 0.719, 0.113,
    0.271, 0.405, 0.006, 0.021, 0.025,
    0.533, 0.872, 0.994, 0.426, 0.768, 0.908, 0.371, 0.705, 0.87, 0.282,
    0.624, 0.81, 0.201, 0.503, 0.72, 0.121, 0.353, 0.582, 0.077, 0.226, 0.401
  )
)
```

```{r fpe-simulate}
fpe_conditions <- distinct(fpe_ref, drug, conc_uM) |>
  mutate(id = row_number())

fpe_grid <- seq(0, 6, by = 0.1)
fpe_obs <- fpe_conditions |>
  tidyr::crossing(time = fpe_grid) |>
  mutate(evid = 0, amt = 0, cmt = "probe")
fpe_dose <- fpe_conditions |>
  filter(conc_uM > 0) |>
  mutate(time = 0, evid = 1, amt = conc_uM * 1000, cmt = "central")
fpe_events <- bind_rows(fpe_dose, fpe_obs) |>
  mutate(
    TRT_ACORAMIDIS = as.numeric(drug == "acoramidis"),
    TRT_TAFAMIDIS = as.numeric(drug == "tafamidis")
  ) |>
  arrange(id, time, desc(evid))

fpe_sim <- rxSolve(
  fpe_mod,
  events = fpe_events,
  keep = c("drug", "conc_uM"),
  atol = 1e-10,
  rtol = 1e-8,
  returnType = "data.frame"
)
```

```{r fpe-figure, fig.height = 4}
ggplot(fpe_sim, aes(time, fluor, colour = factor(conc_uM))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(data = fpe_ref, aes(time, fluor_obs, colour = factor(conc_uM))) +
  facet_wrap(~drug) +
  labs(
    x = "Time (h)",
    y = "Fraction of total fluorescence",
    colour = "Stabiliser (uM)",
    title = "FPE assay in human serum",
    caption = "Replicates Figure S2 of Methven Jeknic 2026 (points: Miller 2018 data)."
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r fpe-check}
fpe_pred <- fpe_ref |>
  mutate(
    TRT_ACORAMIDIS = as.numeric(drug == "acoramidis"),
    TRT_TAFAMIDIS = as.numeric(drug == "tafamidis")
  ) |>
  left_join(fpe_conditions, by = c("drug", "conc_uM"))
fpe_pred_events <- bind_rows(
  filter(fpe_conditions, conc_uM > 0) |>
    mutate(time = 0, evid = 1, amt = conc_uM * 1000, cmt = "central"),
  mutate(fpe_pred, evid = 0, amt = 0, cmt = "probe")
) |>
  mutate(
    TRT_ACORAMIDIS = as.numeric(drug == "acoramidis"),
    TRT_TAFAMIDIS = as.numeric(drug == "tafamidis")
  ) |>
  arrange(id, time, desc(evid))
fpe_at_obs <- rxSolve(
  fpe_mod,
  events = fpe_pred_events,
  keep = c("drug", "conc_uM"),
  atol = 1e-10,
  rtol = 1e-8,
  returnType = "data.frame"
) |>
  select(id, time, fluor)
fpe_cmp <- fpe_pred |>
  left_join(fpe_at_obs, by = c("id", "time")) |>
  mutate(diff = fluor - fluor_obs)

fpe_cmp |>
  group_by(drug) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    median_abs_diff = median(abs(diff)),
    max_abs_diff = max(abs(diff)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)

stopifnot(
  nrow(fpe_cmp) == 36,
  !anyNA(fpe_cmp$diff),
  # Wrong Kd units, a missing factor 2 on the first-site off-rate or an
  # albumin site count of 1 instead of 4 shifts these curves by 0.2-0.5.
  median(abs(fpe_cmp$diff)) < 0.05,
  max(abs(fpe_cmp$diff)) < 0.12
)
```

The fit is close for acoramidis and for tafamidis at 20-40 uM, and runs a few
points of fluorescence high for tafamidis at 1.25-10 uM. The paper weighted the
DMSO control and near-physiological concentrations more heavily (Supplemental
Methods 1.2.3) and combined the curves with protein-binding targets, so an
exact match to every curve is not expected.

# Physiological model

## Simulation set-up

Each scenario starts from the Table S2 initial state (the genotype's measured
serum tetramer, 41.1 nM monomer, 2600 uM albumin sites) and runs for 30 months
(a month is 30 days, as in the authors' code). The stabiliser is a single bolus
into `central` at time 0, which fixes the total drug concentration for the whole
run because the model releases bound drug when a complex is cleared.
Vutrisiran starts at time 0.

```{r qsp-scenarios}
scenarios <- tidyr::crossing(
  drug = c("none", "acoramidis", "tafamidis", "vutrisiran"),
  genotype = c("ATTRwt", "ATTRv", "p.Thr139Met")
) |>
  mutate(
    id = row_number(),
    conc_uM = case_when(drug == "acoramidis" ~ 10, drug == "tafamidis" ~ 26, TRUE ~ 0),
    SNP_TTR_RS76992529 = as.numeric(genotype == "ATTRv"),
    SNP_TTR_RS28933981 = as.numeric(genotype == "p.Thr139Met"),
    TRT_ACORAMIDIS = as.numeric(drug == "acoramidis"),
    TRT_TAFAMIDIS = as.numeric(drug == "tafamidis"),
    TRT_VUTRISIRAN = as.numeric(drug == "vutrisiran"),
    STUDY_HELIOS_A = 0
  )

month_h <- 720
obs_times <- sort(unique(c(seq(0, 30 * month_h, by = 24), 3 * month_h)))

qsp_events_for <- function(sc) {
  obs <- tidyr::crossing(sc, time = obs_times) |>
    mutate(evid = 0, amt = 0, cmt = "ttr_tetramer")
  dose <- sc |>
    filter(conc_uM > 0) |>
    mutate(time = 0, evid = 1, amt = conc_uM * 1000, cmt = "central")
  bind_rows(dose, obs) |>
    arrange(id, time, desc(evid))
}

qsp_sim <- rxSolve(
  qsp_mod,
  events = qsp_events_for(scenarios),
  keep = c("drug", "genotype", "conc_uM"),
  atol = 1e-10,
  rtol = 1e-8,
  maxsteps = 1e6,
  returnType = "data.frame"
) |>
  mutate(month = time / month_h)
```

## Mass balance

The stabiliser pool is closed: free drug, drug on tetramer (one per singly and
two per doubly bound tetramer) and drug on albumin must add up to the dose at
every time.

```{r mass-balance}
drug_balance <- qsp_sim |>
  filter(conc_uM > 0) |>
  mutate(rel_err = abs(drug_total - conc_uM * 1000) / (conc_uM * 1000))
max(drug_balance$rel_err)
stopifnot(max(drug_balance$rel_err) < 1e-5)
```

## Serum TTR over time (Figure 5a)

The HELIOS-B points are the authors' digitised serum TTR reductions, converted
to mg/dL against the untreated ATTRwt starting value as in their code.

```{r fig5a}
helios_b <- data.frame(
  month = c(1.5, 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21, 22.5, 24, 27, 30),
  silencing = c(
    0.6527, 0.625, 0.7037, 0.7754, 0.787, 0.787, 0.799, 0.792, 0.792,
    0.775, 0.78, 0.801
  )
)
ttr_wt_start <- qsp_sim |>
  filter(drug == "none", genotype == "ATTRwt", time == 0) |>
  pull(ttr)
helios_b$ttr <- (1 - helios_b$silencing) * ttr_wt_start

qsp_sim |>
  filter(drug != "tafamidis", genotype != "p.Thr139Met") |>
  ggplot(aes(month, ttr, colour = drug, linetype = genotype)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(data = helios_b, aes(month, ttr), inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "#e7004c") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(none = "grey40", acoramidis = "#4b0082", vutrisiran = "#e7004c")) +
  labs(
    x = "Time (months)",
    y = "Serum TTR (mg/dL)",
    colour = NULL,
    linetype = NULL,
    caption = "Replicates Figure 5a of Methven Jeknic 2026 (points: HELIOS-B)."
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

## End-of-simulation metrics (Figures 3b and 4)

The metrics follow the authors' definitions: fractions of tetramer and of drug
bound at month 30; the share of TTR (in tetramer equivalents) that leaves as
monomer through clearance rather than intact or as amyloid; the change in
total serum tetramer against the same genotype untreated; and the amyloid
formed by month 30 (the monomer-efflux AUC).

```{r metrics}
end30 <- qsp_sim |>
  filter(time == max(time))
untreated <- end30 |>
  filter(drug == "none") |>
  select(genotype, ttr_untreated = ttr, amyloid_untreated = amyloid)
amyloid_wt_untreated <- untreated$amyloid_untreated[untreated$genotype == "ATTRwt"]

metrics <- end30 |>
  left_join(untreated, by = "genotype") |>
  transmute(
    drug, genotype,
    ttr_mg_dl = ttr,
    tetramer_bound_pct = 100 * frac_tet_bound,
    drug_on_tetramer_pct = 100 * frac_drug_tet,
    drug_on_albumin_pct = 100 * frac_drug_alb,
    monomer_clearance_pct = 100 * frac_mon_clear,
    ttr_increase_pct = 100 * (ttr / ttr_untreated - 1),
    efflux_reduction_pct = 100 * (1 - amyloid / amyloid_untreated),
    efflux_vs_untreated_wt = amyloid / amyloid_wt_untreated
  )

metrics |>
  arrange(genotype, drug) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 1)
```

```{r fig4a, fig.height = 3.5}
metrics |>
  filter(drug %in% c("acoramidis", "tafamidis"), genotype == "ATTRwt") |>
  select(drug, tetramer_bound_pct, drug_on_tetramer_pct, drug_on_albumin_pct, monomer_clearance_pct) |>
  pivot_longer(-drug, names_to = "metric", values_to = "pct") |>
  ggplot(aes(metric, pct / 100, fill = drug)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(acoramidis = "#4b0082", tafamidis = "#1f77b4")) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Fraction",
    fill = NULL,
    caption = "Replicates Figure 4a of Methven Jeknic 2026 (ATTRwt, month 30)."
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))
```

## Vutrisiran and the monomer-efflux time course (Figures 5b and 5c)

```{r fig5bc}
efflux_norm <- qsp_sim |>
  filter(drug %in% c("none", "acoramidis", "vutrisiran"), genotype != "p.Thr139Met") |>
  mutate(efflux_norm = amyloid / amyloid_wt_untreated)

efflux_norm |>
  filter(month <= 3) |>
  ggplot(aes(month, efflux_norm, colour = drug, linetype = genotype)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(none = "grey40", acoramidis = "#4b0082", vutrisiran = "#e7004c")) +
  labs(
    x = "Time (months)",
    y = "Normalized monomer efflux",
    colour = NULL,
    linetype = NULL,
    caption = "Replicates Figure 5c of Methven Jeknic 2026."
  ) +
  theme_bw()

month3 <- qsp_sim |>
  filter(time == 3 * month_h) |>
  select(drug, genotype, amyloid) |>
  left_join(
    qsp_sim |>
      filter(time == 3 * month_h, drug == "none") |>
      select(genotype, amyloid_untreated = amyloid),
    by = "genotype"
  ) |>
  mutate(efflux_reduction_month3_pct = 100 * (1 - amyloid / amyloid_untreated))
```

## Comparison with the published values

Every percentage below is quoted in the Results text; the efflux ratios are read
from the Figure 5b bars. The model is deterministic, so the only difference
from the published values is the paper's rounding to whole percentages.

```{r compare}
pick <- function(d, dr, ge, col) d[[col]][d$drug == dr & d$genotype == ge]
comparison <- tribble(
  ~quantity, ~source, ~published, ~model,
  "Tetramers bound, acoramidis, ATTRwt (%)", "Results; Fig 4a", 96, pick(metrics, "acoramidis", "ATTRwt", "tetramer_bound_pct"),
  "Tetramers bound, tafamidis, ATTRwt (%)", "Results; Fig 4a", 82, pick(metrics, "tafamidis", "ATTRwt", "tetramer_bound_pct"),
  "Drug on albumin, acoramidis (%)", "Results; Fig 4a", 27, pick(metrics, "acoramidis", "ATTRwt", "drug_on_albumin_pct"),
  "Drug on albumin, tafamidis (%)", "Results; Fig 4a", 82, pick(metrics, "tafamidis", "ATTRwt", "drug_on_albumin_pct"),
  "Monomer share of clearance, ATTRwt (%)", "Results; Fig 3b", 15, pick(metrics, "none", "ATTRwt", "monomer_clearance_pct"),
  "Monomer share of clearance, ATTRv (%)", "Results; Fig 3b", 41, pick(metrics, "none", "ATTRv", "monomer_clearance_pct"),
  "Monomer share of clearance, p.Thr139Met (%)", "Results; Fig 3b", 1, pick(metrics, "none", "p.Thr139Met", "monomer_clearance_pct"),
  "TTR increase, acoramidis, ATTRwt (%)", "Results; Fig 4b", 19, pick(metrics, "acoramidis", "ATTRwt", "ttr_increase_pct"),
  "TTR increase, tafamidis, ATTRwt (%)", "Results; Fig 4b", 15, pick(metrics, "tafamidis", "ATTRwt", "ttr_increase_pct"),
  "TTR increase, acoramidis, ATTRv (%)", "Results; Fig 4b", 72, pick(metrics, "acoramidis", "ATTRv", "ttr_increase_pct"),
  "TTR increase, tafamidis, ATTRv (%)", "Results; Fig 4b", 55, pick(metrics, "tafamidis", "ATTRv", "ttr_increase_pct"),
  "Efflux reduction, acoramidis, ATTRwt (%)", "Results; Fig 4c", 96, pick(metrics, "acoramidis", "ATTRwt", "efflux_reduction_pct"),
  "Efflux reduction, acoramidis, ATTRv (%)", "Results; Fig 4c", 94, pick(metrics, "acoramidis", "ATTRv", "efflux_reduction_pct"),
  "Efflux reduction, tafamidis, ATTRwt (%)", "Results; Fig 4c", 79, pick(metrics, "tafamidis", "ATTRwt", "efflux_reduction_pct"),
  "Efflux reduction, tafamidis, ATTRv (%)", "Results; Fig 4c", 72, pick(metrics, "tafamidis", "ATTRv", "efflux_reduction_pct"),
  "Efflux reduction, vutrisiran, ATTRwt, month 30 (%)", "Results; Fig 5b", 75, pick(metrics, "vutrisiran", "ATTRwt", "efflux_reduction_pct"),
  "Efflux reduction, vutrisiran, ATTRv, month 30 (%)", "Results; Fig 5b", 75, pick(metrics, "vutrisiran", "ATTRv", "efflux_reduction_pct"),
  "Efflux reduction, vutrisiran, ATTRwt, month 3 (%)", "Results; Fig 5c", 61, pick(month3, "vutrisiran", "ATTRwt", "efflux_reduction_month3_pct"),
  "Efflux reduction, acoramidis, ATTRwt, month 3 (%)", "Results; Fig 5c", 96, pick(month3, "acoramidis", "ATTRwt", "efflux_reduction_month3_pct"),
  "Untreated ATTRv efflux / ATTRwt (ratio)", "Fig 5b bar", 2.5, pick(metrics, "none", "ATTRv", "efflux_vs_untreated_wt"),
  "Vutrisiran ATTRwt efflux / untreated ATTRwt (ratio)", "Fig 5b bar", 0.25, pick(metrics, "vutrisiran", "ATTRwt", "efflux_vs_untreated_wt"),
  "Vutrisiran ATTRv efflux / untreated ATTRwt (ratio)", "Fig 5b bar", 0.62, pick(metrics, "vutrisiran", "ATTRv", "efflux_vs_untreated_wt")
) |>
  mutate(difference = model - published)

comparison |>
  dplyr::rename(
    Quantity = quantity,
    Source = source,
    Published = published,
    Model = model,
    Difference = difference
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)

pct_rows <- grepl("(%)", comparison$quantity, fixed = TRUE)
stopifnot(
  # Published percentages are whole numbers; a mis-transcribed rate constant
  # moves these by several points.
  all(abs(comparison$difference[pct_rows]) <= 1.5),
  # Figure 5b ratios are read off a bar chart.
  all(abs(comparison$difference[!pct_rows]) <= 0.05)
)
```

## Sensitivity cases

The paper repeats the stabiliser comparison with acoramidis at 8 uM (Figure S7)
and tafamidis at 35 uM (Figure S8), and the vutrisiran comparison with the
HELIOS-A knockdown (Figure S12). Acoramidis keeps the larger reduction in
monomer efflux in every case.

```{r sensitivity}
sens <- tibble::tibble(
  case = c("acoramidis 8 uM", "tafamidis 35 uM", "vutrisiran (HELIOS-A)"),
  drug = c("acoramidis", "tafamidis", "vutrisiran"),
  conc_uM = c(8, 35, 0),
  STUDY_HELIOS_A = c(0, 0, 1)
) |>
  tidyr::crossing(genotype = c("ATTRwt", "ATTRv")) |>
  mutate(
    id = row_number(),
    SNP_TTR_RS76992529 = as.numeric(genotype == "ATTRv"),
    SNP_TTR_RS28933981 = 0,
    TRT_ACORAMIDIS = as.numeric(drug == "acoramidis"),
    TRT_TAFAMIDIS = as.numeric(drug == "tafamidis"),
    TRT_VUTRISIRAN = as.numeric(drug == "vutrisiran")
  )

sens_end <- rxSolve(
  qsp_mod,
  events = qsp_events_for(sens),
  keep = c("case", "genotype"),
  atol = 1e-10,
  rtol = 1e-8,
  maxsteps = 1e6,
  returnType = "data.frame"
) |>
  filter(time == max(time)) |>
  left_join(untreated, by = "genotype") |>
  transmute(
    case, genotype,
    tetramer_bound_pct = 100 * frac_tet_bound,
    ttr_increase_pct = 100 * (ttr / ttr_untreated - 1),
    efflux_reduction_pct = 100 * (1 - amyloid / amyloid_untreated)
  )
knitr::kable(sens_end, digits = 1)

base_red <- metrics |>
  filter(drug %in% c("acoramidis", "tafamidis", "vutrisiran"), genotype != "p.Thr139Met") |>
  select(drug, genotype, efflux_reduction_pct)
stopifnot(
  # Figure S7: acoramidis at 8 uM still beats tafamidis at 26 uM.
  all(
    sens_end$efflux_reduction_pct[sens_end$case == "acoramidis 8 uM"] >
      base_red$efflux_reduction_pct[base_red$drug == "tafamidis"][match(
        sens_end$genotype[sens_end$case == "acoramidis 8 uM"],
        base_red$genotype[base_red$drug == "tafamidis"]
      )] + 5
  ),
  # Figure S8: tafamidis at 35 uM still trails acoramidis at 10 uM.
  all(
    sens_end$efflux_reduction_pct[sens_end$case == "tafamidis 35 uM"] <
      base_red$efflux_reduction_pct[base_red$drug == "acoramidis"][match(
        sens_end$genotype[sens_end$case == "tafamidis 35 uM"],
        base_red$genotype[base_red$drug == "acoramidis"]
      )] - 5
  )
)
```

# NCA

PKNCA is not used. Neither model has drug pharmacokinetics: the stabilisers are
held at a constant total concentration and vutrisiran acts through an empirical
knockdown trajectory, so there is no concentration-time profile to summarise.
The checks above replace it: agreement of the FPE model with the assay data, a
closed drug mass balance, and reproduction of every quantitative result the
paper reports for the physiological model.

# Assumptions and deviations

* **Authors' code followed for implementation details.** The supplement and the
  authors' code deposit (<https://github.com/BridgeBioAnalytics/ttr-mechanistic-model>,
  commit 6686acd) agree on the physiological equations and on every Table S6
  value to the printed precision. The code was followed for the initial state
  (Table S2 values; the model is not started at steady state, so the first
  days include a short transient in monomer and tetramer), for the release of
  bound stabiliser when a stabiliser-bound tetramer is cleared, and for the
  mg/dL conversion (TTR tetramer 55 kDa).
* **Vutrisiran silencing parameters are a refit.** The paper describes, but does
  not print, the single-exponential fits to the HELIOS-B and HELIOS-A serum TTR
  reductions. The maintainers refitted the authors' deposited digitised data
  with the code's model form, `s(t) = smax - (smax - s0) * exp(-ksil * t)` for
  t > 0, with two optimisers that agreed to five significant figures. As in the
  code, the silencing before the first post-dose visit is held at its value at
  that visit (6 weeks for HELIOS-B), modelling the maximal early effect. The
  constant 83% knockdown of the vutrisiran label (a fitting target in Table S4)
  can be reproduced by setting `smax_heliosb = s0_heliosb = 0.83` with `ini()`.
* **Stabiliser association rate.** Table S6 lists kaD,1 and kaD,2 separately
  for each drug, all 3.6e10 1/M/h (assumed); the model carries one
  `kon_ttr`. Albumin association is likewise one `kon_alb`.
* **Typographical errors in the supplement.** Table S6 gives kdT:D and kdT:D2
  the unit 1/(M h); they multiply a concentration in a first-order term and are
  1/h, as in the code. Supplemental Equation 2 omits the factor 2 on the
  kdD,2 [T:D2] term that Equations 3 and 7 carry; the model includes it, as
  the code and the physiological Equation 9 do, so drug is conserved. The FPE
  equations print no equation for the free probe; the model depletes it by the
  covalent reaction, as the code does.
* **Table S5 vs Table 1 (FPE model).** For acoramidis, the Table S5 off-rates
  (kdD,1 457.6, kdD,2 4859, kdD,A 7820 1/h) do not match the Table 1
  dissociation constants under the model's binding convention (they imply
  6.36 nM, 270 nM and 217 uM). Table 1, the code and the 37 C off-rates of
  Table S6 (after the stated 2.43-fold van 't Hoff correction) all agree, so
  the FPE model uses the Table 1 constants and derives the off-rates as
  kdD1 = 2 kaD Kd1, kdD2 = kaD Kd2 / 2, kdDA = kaDA Kd,A. The probe rate ki and
  readout slope s are taken from Table S5 (1.926e5 1/M/h, 1.0589); the code
  carries 1.9235e5 and 1.0585.
* **"Nearly twice" vs 2.5.** The abstract and Discussion say untreated ATTRv
  incurs nearly twice the monomer efflux of ATTRwt; the model, the code and
  the Figure 5b bar all give 2.5.
* **Genotype indicators.** The ATTRv parameter set is selected by
  `SNP_TTR_RS76992529` (p.Val142Ile) because the paper parameterises its ATTRv
  cohort on that variant; it also carries cohort-mean ATTRv serum TTR, so it
  represents the ATTRv trial population rather than strictly V142I carriers.
* **No variability.** The paper calibrates to cohort means and reports no
  between-subject variability or residual error; its parameter-sampling
  sensitivity analyses (log-normal multipliers with sigma 0.25 on every
  parameter) are not part of the model.
